theme: Source diversification (8 central banks + FRED) + Backtest framework

newOptionalFields: CourtInput.backtestMode (skips freshness vetoes for historical replay)

changedFiles.reason: Direct primary-source RSS for Fed, ECB, BoE, BoJ, RBA, BoC, RBNZ, SNB. Bypasses intermediary delay.
FRED CSV endpoint for DXY proxy, US10Y/2Y, VIX, oil, gold, fed funds. No API key. Historical data for Phase 2 backtest.
TradingView primary, FRED fallback. Adds sourceUsed map for per-indicator provenance audit.
Wires central-bank direct feeds as 4th parallel source in fetchNewsForPair. CB items prioritized in dedupe.
Body of analyzePair extracted into pure runCourt(input). Backtest can now invoke engine logic with pre-loaded historical data.
HistData.com Generic ASCII M1 CSV loader. EST→UTC conversion. Resampling M1→M5/M15/H1/H4/D1.
Walks M1 candles, calls runCourt at every Nth bar, computes WIN/LOSS/TIMEOUT outcome by scanning forward bars for SL/TP hit.
Bins records by |composite|. Computes win-rate, net pips, expectancy per bin, per verdict, per confidence tier.
CLI entrypoint. Loads CSV → runs replay → prints calibration tables → optional JSON dump.
Full documentation of source diversification + backtest framework.

knownLimitations: Central-bank RSS URLs cannot be probed from this development sandbox (egress firewall blocks all 8 domains). Production verification must happen from Cloudflare Workers deployment via the source-health pill bar.
RBNZ feed flagged REQUIRES_FIRST_RUN_CHECK due to historical URL changes.
DXY proxy via FRED's DTWEXBGS is Trade-Weighted USD Broad, not ICE DXY. Correlated ~0.95 but not identical.
Backtest Phase 1: news engine, calendar, and macro context are stubbed. Calibrates technical engines only.
HistData volumes are always 0; resampler uses M1 bar count as synthetic volume proxy.
deferredToNextRound: Phase 2 backtest: historical news archive, FairEconomy calendar archive, FRED historical context per replay date
Confidence calibration loop: use calibrate.ts output to replace |composite| heuristic with empirical win-rates
Trade journal: persistent storage of live verdicts + outcomes for continuous calibration refresh
